'''Alex Tennet Search And Destroy''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Alex Tennet]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds123.htm Search And Destroy], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001018023015/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds123.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
